briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race intensifies as China unveils DeepSeek-R2

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has accelerated with multiple frontier releases this month. US labs maintain lead but Chinese models close capability gap rapidly. Investment remains robust amid regulatory scrutiny.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-R2 from China matches GPT-4o performance at lower cost. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins next quarter.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA H200 shipments surge; Microsoft and Google announce $50B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. TSMC 2nm process yields improve for AI chips.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models from Meta and DeepSeek overtake closed frontier labs by end of 2027?
